overview.headline: High unresolved onboarding and integration gaps driving demand for integrations and creating measurable churn risk
overview.summary: Across 30 records we see a negative tilt (15 negative, 6 positive, 9 neutral) with 24 unresolved issues (80%) and 19 explicit feature requests (63.3%). Onboarding is the single largest topic (6 mentions) followed by integration and feature requests (each 5 mentions); performance and reporting also recur. Specific asks and pain points include missing Salesforce/CRM integrations, no mobile app, reporting export limitations and onboarding friction. Churn signals are present (6 records, 20%) and concentrate around onboarding and integration problems.
overview.priority: Immediately reduce the 24 unresolved issues by triaging and closing onboarding and integration tickets (prioritize Salesforce/CRM integration questions, mobile capability gaps, and reporting/export blockers).

problems.name: missing salesforce integration
problems.summary: The most important recurring problem is onboarding friction compounded by missing integrations and capability gaps. Customers repeatedly report difficulty completing setup and key workflows during onboarding and call out absent integrations (Salesforce/CRM), lack of a mobile app, and reporting/export limitations that prevent them from realizing value.

feature_request_insight: A majority of feature demand centers on integrations and export/reporting capabilities: integration topics lead feature requests (5 mentions) and top problems explicitly call out missing Salesforce/CRM integrations. Other explicit capability gaps include requests for a mobile app and Slack notifications and a required reporting export. The wording in records (e.g., 'missing salesforce integration', 'no mobile app') indicates these capabilities are currently absent or insufficient for customers' needs.
churn_insight: There is measurable retention risk: 6 churn signals (20%) align with onboarding and integration topics (onboarding and integration each appear in churn-topic records). The very high unresolved-issue rate (80%) amplifies that risk—customers stuck in setup or lacking critical integrations are more likely to cancel. Pricing and performance concerns also appear among churn topics and could become additional drivers if unresolved.
